description: Talk to your customer data in plain language, directly in ChatGPT. Analyze your survey responses, reviews, and AI-driven Intelligence from Zonka Feedback — just by asking. Get insights into survey metrics like NPS, CES, CSAT and Sentiment, and deep dive into AI-derived themes to make better sense of your data across various customer touchpoints like chats, tickets and reviews — to get actionable insights and act on them.
